title: Startup-ready release work
items: Release verification: signed checksums, per-archive SBOMs, and build provenance.
Tool-capable Responses and Messages API subsets with streaming; OpenAI image and audio endpoints.
Token and spend limits, sourced modality pricing, versioned migrations, and retention.
Per-tool MCP discovery filtering and configurable token exchange (Beta).
An authenticated operator console with roles and live request, policy, provider, and budget data.
note: Prepared release scope, not a published release. Read the final product release notes and corrected register before deploying these additions.

title: Release verification candidate
items: A planned pre-release tag for validating install, signing, SBOMs, attestations, and deployment checks.
note: No beta tag or artifact is assumed to exist; use the pinned source-build quickstart.

title: Initial public release
items: The self-hosted Go gateway, provider routing, local guardrails, request logs, and beta agent protocols.
note: Use the current evaluation guide rather than assuming the older release has the v0.2.0 install fixes.
